title: Remove Launch app handler flat aliases
summary: Removed four Launch app-handler flat compatibility aliases by switching app-level startup, start/rerun, and pipeline-control event handlers to the mediaPipelineLaunchView namespace.
reason: The WebView cleanup workstream is reducing transitional flat window.* exports opportunistically while preserving namespace-first access and existing backend-owned command boundaries.
behavior_before: app.js called Launch startup, pipeline start, CSV rerun, and pipeline-control handlers through direct flat globals, so launchView.js kept matching window.* compatibility assignments.
behavior_after: app.js resolves window.mediaPipelineLaunchView once during DOMContentLoaded and calls Launch handlers through that namespace. launchView.js no longer exports requestPipelineControl, startPipelineFromForm, startRerunFromForm, or initLaunchViewEvents as flat globals; intentional Launch test/split hooks remain unchanged.
tests_added: Tightened LocalApiServerTests.test_local_api_serves_read_only_web_prototype assertions for namespace-backed Launch handlers and absence of removed flat assignments.
manual_validation: npm run webview:contract (OK; regenerated public contract baseline)
npm run webview:map (OK; regenerated stale WebView split map after prework map check)
npm run webview:prework:check (OK after regenerating WebView split map)
rollback_plan: Restore the four launchView.js flat assignments and the direct app.js call sites, then rerun WebView contract/prework checks and the targeted Launch tests.
